'''Maarten Solleveld'''  is a Dutch [[chess]] grandmaster and mathematician.

==Chess career==
He won the 2000 Gouda Open ahead of IM Johan van Mil.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.messemaker-1847.nl/OKG2022/Eregalerij.php|title=Eregalerij van het Open Kampioenschap van Gouda 1993-2022}}</ref>

He achieved his GM norms at the:<ref name="FIDEGM"/>
*Dutch Team Championship in June 2003
*North Sea Cup in July 2005
*Dutch Team Competition in April 2012

He has been inactive in chess since June 2017.

==Mathematics career==
He obtained his PhD in mathematics from the [[University of Amsterdam]] in 2007 under Eric Opdam.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://gqt.nl/for-researchers/members/maarten-solleveld/#:~:text=Maarten%20Solleveld%20(1979)%20studied%20mathematics,the%20supervision%20of%20Eric%20Opdam|title=Maarten Solleveld}}</ref> He has held teaching positions at University of Amsterdam, [[Hausdorff Center for Mathematics]], and [[University of Göttingen]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.chess.com/news/view/chess-and-math-a-happy-couple|title=Chess and math: a happy couple?|date=August 31, 2011}}</ref> In 2011, he became a professor of mathematics at [[Radboud University Nijmegen]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.math.ru.nl/~solleveld/index.php|title=Welcome to Maarten Solleveld's homepage}}</ref>
